Team — forwarding Jessica's note below. She just canceled for illness. Quick options so we can decide ASAP before adjacent calendar slots lock down: 

1) Reschedule full panel to Wed May 6 morning or Thu May 7 after 1pm PT (Jessica provided availability).
2) Proceed today with a shortened 1:1 with Laura (hiring manager) and do technical follow-up later — would keep our pipeline moving but means two interview rounds.
3) If someone on the panel prefers to keep their existing candidate slot for another interview, we can reassign and maintain the schedule; otherwise we'll open the slot for a different candidate.

Laura: hiring manager call? Do you want to do an abbreviated 30-min conversation today at 10 to keep momentum?
Tessa/Markus: are you available to do a 30-min pass at 10 if Laura wants to proceed? If not, I can rebook.
Dev: I can coordinate calendar updates + Greenhouse if we pick a new time.

Thanks — please reply with a quick thumb (yes/no) so I can lock in the plan and notify Jessica/our ATS.
